name: PalSystem_Dragapult
strategy_notes: Establish multiple Dreepy before committing limited Bench slots.
Use each available Recon Directive before evolving that Drakloak when ordering permits.
Route Fire and Psychic Energy toward a Phantom Dive attacker; route Darkness Energy to Munkidori when Adrena-Brain can create value.
Evaluate Phantom Dive bench-counter placement by live HP, prize value, and future knockout setup rather than printed card power.
Treat Budew, Fezandipiti ex, Meowth ex, Unfair Stamp, and disruption Supporters as timing-dependent resources rather than automatic plays.
